purpose: Confirm paired low-differential tracking and stopping behavior for capped-P versus a runtime per-side integral counterfactual under the same v5 Newton environment.

prior_attempt.pair_exit: paired_counterfactual_attempt1_exit.json reports actual_exit_code=1 because exact settle-state equality failed
prior_attempt.exact_pair_gate: The earlier 10-case exact initial-state comparison failed and remains preserved with exit code 1. This confirmation uses the explicit tolerances below; it does not rewrite the earlier result as a pass.

confirmation_p.name: capped_p_only_reference
confirmation_p.integral_assertion: side integral state and broadcast feedforward remain exactly zero

confirmation_pi.name: runtime_pi_counterfactual
confirmation_pi.ki_status: uncalibrated assumption; do not tune during this experiment
confirmation_pi.ki_units: Nm per proxy wheel / (rad/s side-mean proxy wheel speed * s)

controllers.integral_states: two states in left/right order, each updated from the mean target-minus-actual angular velocity across that side's seven proxy wheels; broadcast each side value equally to its seven proxy wheels
controllers.native_pd: Preserve the configured per-wheel IdealPD gain and v5 effort clamp; do not change actuator or physics configuration.

initial_state_pairing_tolerances.comparison_rule: For every selected case and every listed element, absolute PI-minus-P difference must be less than or equal to the field tolerance. Record actual maximum absolute differences by field.

braking_stop_gate.failure_rule: A gate failure is reported as failure; do not relax any threshold, change Ki, or call this navigation/goal-completion success.

execution_guard: Prepared only. Do not execute native/GPU runs until the parent agent explicitly authorizes them after reviewing the old initial-state deltas.
